Maria Chen: Heads up — month-end question re: Acme Corp prepaid reserved capacity invoice. Sales submitted request to change revenue schedule. Need finance input + approval. Invoice 92345 attached. :eyes:

Aj Patel: Can you post invoice details? term length, invoice date, service start?

Maria Chen: Invoice 92345, dated 2026-02-15, $120,000 prepaid for 12-month Dedicated Reserved Capacity starting 2026-02-15. Sales wants to recognize starting Feb 1 instead of service start (claims customer negotiating start date). We're seeing mismatch in deferred rev balance. Attached file in thread.

rev-bot: Invoice 92345 uploaded by sales@acme.com to /invoices/92345.pdf

Aj Patel: We should prorate for the initial partial month. If svc starts 2026-02-15, partial Feb is 14 days (15-28). Recognition approach: defer $120,000 and amortize monthly from 2026-02-15. For Feb partial: $120k*(14/365)=~$4,607 to recognize in Feb; remaining recognized monthly = ($120k - partial)/11 = ~ $10,410 per month. Need to confirm whether company policy allows start-of-month recognition — typically no unless explicit contract change. :thinking_face:

Oliver Grant: Agree with Aj. We need Sales/SPOC to sign amendment to change effective recognition date. Otherwise we book deferral and amortize on service start. @Sarah Kim, need sign-off to apply accounting treatment if we accept Sales' request (it will accelerate rev by ~$5k in Feb and shift future months).

Sarah Kim: Reviewed. No change to recognition date without signed amendment. Don't accelerate. Proceed with deferral journal and regular monthly recognition. Approve AJ to post adjusting JE for month-end. :white_check_mark:
